mapper.select: SELECT t.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, SUM(t.amount) AS myAmount, ps.avg_amount AS peerAmount FROM transaction t JOIN category c ON t.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN peer_stat ps ON ps.category_id = t.category_id AND ps.age_group = #{ageGroup} WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.txn_type = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(t.txn_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY t.category_id, c.name, ps.avg_amount ORDER BY myAmount DESC LIMIT 3
